title: Local dimension of a pure-dimensional locally algebraic open
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $Y$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with a locally finite type morphism $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], $O\subseteq Y$ an open, and $n\in\mathbb N$. Suppose every irreducible component $C$ of $O$ [def-weil-irreducible-components] has topological Krull dimension $n$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Then for every $x\in O$ the local topological dimension of $Y$ at $x$ [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point] is $n$.

proof.text: In the sober open subspace O, write its topological dimension as the supremum of heights for the specialization order, equivalently the dimensions of closures of points. Each closure embeds into an irreducible component through the point. Every component has dimension n, so dim O <= n. Monotonicity under subspace embeddings gives dim U <= n for every open neighbourhood U.

For x in O, choose its irreducible component C and construct the closed subscheme R of O from the vanishing ideal of C (Mathlib IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal, subscheme, subschemeι). The closed immersion i has range C, so R is homeomorphic to C and irreducible. The composite R -> O -> Y -> Spec k is locally of finite type. For a neighbourhood U of x, its inverse image V in R is nonempty, since x belongs to C. Apply dimension_locally_algebraic to R and V: dim V = dim R = dim C = n. The restricted embedding V -> U then gives n <= dim U.
All open neighbourhoods of x in O have dimension n, so topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_of_forall computes their infimum as n. IsOpen.topologicalKrullDimAt_eq transports this value from O to Y.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A21 (3); component reduction and dimension monotonicity
